3400.name: Coin Operated Timer Board Control Panel
3400.content:
![](/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/timerboard-splash.png)

Game Wizard Xtreme now supports coin operated function via its Coin Operated Timer Board Control Panel.

Highly suitable for internet cafes and rentals where customers can add their own game accounts to the machine and rent the game cabinet from you on time.

Highly configurable, the new Coin Operated Timer Board Control Panel offers owners to customise settings including welcome screen, set multiple timer options including bonus time, setting the machine on coin or free play, and much more.

The new coin operated timer board control panel also has LED display with LED multicolour lighting with colour matching for time remaining.

## See How The  Coin Operated Timer Board Control Panel Works

<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/KgtWkdIr8d8" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen="allowfullscreen" style="aspect-ratio:16/9;width:100%"></iframe>

## Coin Operated Timer Board Control Panel Features

![](/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/timer-attract-mode1.gif)

![Coin Operated Timer Board Control Panel display](/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/display-300x200.png)

![Coin Operated Timer Board Control Panel update](/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/update-300x200.png)

Our new Coin Operated Timer Board Control Panel contains  an LED display with LED multicolour lighting featuring an attract mode and colour coded displays for time remaining.

Customisable settings including a welcome screen is a unique feature to the Coin Operated Timer Board Control Panel,  bonus time allowing you to build up your time. You can also use the timer board for free play, coin operated or time based.

Simply update your existing Game Wizard Xtreme control panel to the new Coin Operated Timer Board Control Panel for a whole new gaming experience.
